title: Replayed-prefix statement swap to URL close
summary: One centred line on dark navy, then the same line replays with only its last word changed, then an eyebrow and a big URL, then an availability close. A drifting blue light arc keeps the empty frame alive.
use_when: A site or portal launch where the URL itself is the hero line
Saying the product fits two audiences with one sentence and a changed last word
Silent autoplay feeds where type carries the whole message
A calm, restrained voice on a dark brand

look.type_style: semibold-bold grotesk, sentence case, tight tracking (~-0.02 em), hero line ~11.8 % H (human 30 fps study), period on statements; eyebrow and sub-line ~1.5 % H, same face, muted

structure.shot: statement, 3 words (prefix of 2 + a 1-word audience), centred; thin blue light arc curving in from the left edge
structure.camera: push-in creep on the statement ~1-2 %/s (motion.json zoom 2.0, 1.2 %/s; not measurable on sheets); arc drifts and rotates slowly
structure.motion: per-word blur-in from f1, stagger 2 fr, easings.outExpo ~10-12 fr, settles ~f12, ~5-10 px downward settle (human 30 fps study); hold to f68; exit f69-74: 5-6 fr fade + blur to ~4 px + slight drop; f75-78 empty

structure.shot: the same statement replayed with only the last word changed; prefix lands in the same pixels so it reads as a word swap
structure.camera: push-in creep continues ~1-3 %/s (motion.json; 3-4 s reads 14.5 %/s while the arc moves, treat as noise); arc rotates toward vertical at left
structure.motion: full per-word replay: words at f79, f81, f83 (stagger 2 fr), full contrast f89-90 (~10 fr, easings.outExpo); sheet 2.77 shows prefix sharp, new word still blurred; hold ~2 s; exit f150-156 same 5-6 fr blur fade

structure.shot: small muted eyebrow (4 words, names what the site is) above a big one-line URL; arc fades left, soft blue glow blooms top centre-right, a bright arc line enters top right from ~7.27
structure.camera: push-in creep ~1.5 %/s (motion.json 6-8 s); background light drifts
structure.motion: eyebrow blur-in f158, URL blur-in 6 fr later (f164), URL settles by 5.77 (±0.25 s, sheet); hold ~2.5 s; exit both lines from ~8.20: 5-6 fr blur fade (sheet 8.27 mid-fade)

structure.shot: availability statement, 3 words, centred; small sub-line pointing to the site URL underneath; broad diagonal blue light band rises lower-left to upper-right behind
structure.camera: push-in creep ~1.4-3.4 %/s (motion.json 9-11 s); light band sweeps up across the frame
structure.motion: per-word blur-in from f254, stagger 2 fr, easings.outExpo ~10 fr (sheet 8.50: 2 words in, second still blurred); sub-line blur-in +12 fr after the statement (human 30 fps study), present by 9.00; hold ~2 s; fade out between 11.00 and 11.27 (±0.25 s), 5-6 fr

params.brand: any brand.json: display font, fg, muted, accent (the light arc colour), bg
params.content.prefix: sentence start shared by both statements, 2-3 words
params.content.words: 2 last words (audiences or uses), 1 word each, with the period
params.content.eyebrow: small muted label above the URL, <= 5 words
params.content.url: the URL as the hero line, one line at 16:9
params.content.sub: small line under the close pointing to the URL
params.timing.period: frames per statement at 30 fps (measured ~78 fr for the first two, ~98 for the URL)
params.arc: drifting light arc on/off and colour (default brand accent)

notes: One shot, no cuts in cuts.json: every handover is continuous. The word swap is not in place: the whole line fades out (5-6 fr), 4 empty frames, then the full per-word entrance replays with the new last word; the prefix landing in the same pixels makes it read as a swap (human 30 fps study). Entrance/exit frame counts and the 2 fr stagger come from the human 30 fps study; sheets resolve 0.25 s. Push-in rate is from motion.json, not measured on sheets. Reference is silent: no SFX observed, none planned. Proposed term (not used as an id): light-arc-drift, a soft blurred blue arc of light that slowly rotates and travels behind the type for the whole film.
